goal: Build the Restraint policy module: pure evaluateAsk/evaluateBatch implementing the closed six-reason Withhold reason enum, first-match precedence, per-Vertical Freshness windows, Velocity banking, and typed Evidence snapshots exactly per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-23-restraint-policy-v-watch.md and ADR 0012.
non_goals: No worker, poller, or UI (batch builder is #543; batch screen is #537)
No DB access anywhere in the module — context is fully loaded by the caller; no sql parameter (ticket #542's 'sql as explicit param' note is superseded by the spec's pure-function posture)
No decision storage (storage home is #534/#543's call)
No suppression ledger (send-mode scope; `suppressed` ships in the enum but has no v-watch source)
No LLM anywhere in the decision path (spec §5.1)
No recent_negative reason, ever (ADR 0012 — permanently rejected)
No schema change, no migration, no owner-facing vertical knob
user_visible_behavior: None directly — library module only. Exported API: evaluateAsk (five per-candidate gates, spec signature) + evaluateBatch (complete evaluation adding velocity_banked), consumed later by #543.

Spec doc gains a footnote: no_consent (like suppressed) cannot fire in v-watch because the #535 consent attestation is blocking — every uploaded candidate is covered by construction; the code is reserved for enum stability.
invariants: Sentiment-blind by construction: no sentiment, star-rating, or review-content field exists on any input or evidence type (already_reviewed evidence carries review_id + review_date only)

Closed enums: exactly six withhold reasons (no_consent, suppressed, already_reviewed, stale_visit, over_contacted, velocity_banked); exactly eight verticals (food_and_drink, retail, personal_care, fitness, medical_dental, automotive, home_services, other)
First-match precedence, one reason per withhold: no_consent → suppressed → already_reviewed → stale_visit → over_contacted → velocity_banked
Pure and deterministic: same candidate + context in, same decision out; decided_at/today come from context, never from Date.now inside the module
Evidence references the candidate by ID only — contact PII never duplicated into evidence; every snapshot carries policy_version + decided_at envelope
stale_visit fires iff today − last_visit_date > freshness_window_days (strictly greater; boundary day is fresh)

Velocity banking keeps most-recent-visit-first up to the batch cap (day-one 25, tunable constant in the same table as windows); ties break on candidate row ID ascending (UUIDv7 time-ordered) so ordering is total
Vertical resolution is a pure deterministic keyword mapper over businesses.category free text, falling back to other; resolved vertical + matched keyword recorded in stale_visit evidence
edge_cases: Empty candidate list → empty decision list
Empty/unmapped category → vertical other (window 30), matched_keyword absent/null
Candidate failing multiple gates → only the first reason in precedence order
eligible_count == batch_cap → nothing banked; eligible_count < cap → nothing banked
All eligible candidates beyond the cap → banked with full evidence (batch_cap, eligible_count, ordering basis)
Same last_visit_date tie at the cap boundary → lower row ID kept
Candidate passing every gate under cap → send with no evidence payload
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/responses/prompt-policy.ts — versioned policy constant (PROMPT_VERSION pattern) for policy_version
src/lib/reviews/sentiment.ts — deterministic pure classifier with closed source tag
Discriminated-union result types per repo TS strict style; named exports only
tests_to_add: Per-reason contract test for each of the six codes: exact fires-when condition + exact evidence field shape
no_consent + suppressed: gate logic tested even though neither can fire in v-watch (footnote), so the enum is stable when send-mode lands
Precedence: candidate constructed to fail all six gates yields no_consent; pairwise earlier-gate-wins cases
Freshness boundary: window, window+1 for at least two verticals; per-vertical window table asserted against spec values
Vertical mapper: at least one keyword per vertical + fallback to other on empty/garbage category
Velocity banking: ordering (most-recent-first), tie-break on row ID, cap-exact and under-cap no-op cases
Sentiment-blindness structural test: evidence snapshots for already_reviewed never contain a rating key (typed + runtime assertion over serialized JSON)

fast-check properties: determinism (same input twice → deepEqual output); every withhold carries exactly one reason and a policy_version + decided_at envelope; banked+sent partition the surviving pool with |sent| ≤ cap; evidence JSON never contains candidate name/email/phone fields
